title: Food Safety & Quality Compliance
thesis: Snowflake parses inspection reports with AI, indexes Thai FDA regulations for instant search, detects compliance anomalies, and auto-alerts quality teams — replacing paper-based food safety with AI-native compliance

talking_points: Overall compliance rate: 91.4% — target is 98%. Six facilities below threshold.
Four hundred twenty million baht in non-compliance costs this year (recalls, fines, lost contracts).
Three critical pathogen detections in the last 30 days requiring product holds.
show: Point at compliance rate gauge (91.4% vs 98% target)
tabs.call_out: 6 facilities below compliance — ฿420M in non-compliance costs

transition.line: Let's see which CCPs are driving the most violations.

talking_points: 500K CCP monitoring records — thermal processing, metal detection, chemical limits.
Shrimp Line-04: cooking temperature CCP showing drift — 7 deviations in 48 hours.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION confirms systematic pattern — not random variation.
show: Show CCP dashboard with status indicators
tabs.call_out: 7 deviations in 48 hours — anomaly confirmed by ML

transition.line: What do the regulations say about this level of deviation?

talking_points: Cortex Search indexes 300 regulatory documents — Thai FDA, CODEX, EU, Japan, US FDA.
Search 'maximum Salmonella limits for frozen shrimp exports to EU' returns exact regulation.
AI generates compliance gap analysis comparing current lab results to regulatory limits.
show: Demo Cortex Search on food regulations
tabs.call_out: 300 regulations searchable — instant multi-market compliance answers

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Dr. Pimchanok asks: 'Which facilities are at highest recall risk right now?'
Cortex Analyst: Samut Sakhon Shrimp (risk 87), Pathum Thani Poultry (risk 72), Nakhon Pathom Meals (risk 64).
Switch to advisor: 'What should we do about Samut Sakhon?' — references inspection findings and recommends corrective actions.
show: Type: 'Facilities ranked by recall risk score'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL compliance analytics + regulatory advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Textract/AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT turns inspection PDFs into structured compliance data.
Thailand is the world's kitchen — ฿1.1T in food exports. This monitors 45 plants, 500K CCP records.
tabs.call_out: Document AI + regulatory search — food safety in one platform

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Thai food safety compliance.
